ValidationRule.description: A line may only be attached to a live payout that belongs to the very subagent on its own policy. Checked only when the stamp is being set or changed, so later edits to a policy can never brick an already settled line.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Payout__c) ), NOT( ISBLANK(Payout__c) ), OR( ISBLANK(Policy_Number__c), ISBLANK(Policy_Number__r.Subagent__c), Payout__r.Agent__c <> Policy_Number__r.Subagent__c, TEXT(Payout__r.Status__c) = "Voided" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This commission line cannot be attached to that payout. The line must have a policy, the policy must have a subagent, that subagent must be the agent on the payout, and the payout must not be voided.
